_meta.role: quarry-equipped agent -- has the quarry CLI (/tmp/quarry-bench) and is instructed to prefer it over grep/read for symbol lookups, references, definitions, toc, and impact analysis

issues_found.description: internal/loomcli's run verb still calls the old free function attachArgv(socket, session string) with c.reed.Socket()/c.reed.SessionName(), instead of the new c.reed.AttachArgv(cols, rows int) method that internal/reedcli/attach.go was correctly updated to use. The old attachArgv symbol no longer exists anywhere in the project, so this caller was missed by the rename and the package fails to build.
issues_found.evidence: quarry refs on Engine.AttachArgv's declaration (internal/reedengine/attach.go:62) lists only internal/reedcli/attach.go:71 as a caller -- internal/loomcli/run.go is absent. quarry definition attachArgv finds no matching symbol in the project. go build ./... in /tmp/loomyard-review-03 fails with 'internal/loomcli/run.go:295:46: undefined: attachArgv'. git diff --cached -- internal/loomcli/run.go shows this line was reverted from the correct c.reed.AttachArgv(cols, rows) call (with a terminal-size read via golang.org/x/term, mirroring reedcli/attach.go) back to the old free-function call.
